multiplicity.family: D4 confirmatory {H4a, H4b, H4c, H4d}; H4e descriptive
multiplicity.bh: BH q-values in T4_1_continuation_ratio.csv (q_bh) and atlas.csv (q_bh)

H4a.statement: Neutral filter for the mainstream fashion: NAME G_total in [0.95, 1.10] every year 2018-26; pooled 2024-26 TOST within [0.90, 1.11]; 2024 slope-change OR equal across ACC, REJ, WD.
H4a.falsification: pooled NAME G_total 90% CI outside [0.90, 1.11], or pool-specific break ORs differ at p < .05
H4a.verdict_label: supported for the observed (published vs submitted) NAME share; review-stage neutrality not identified
H4a.notes: Pooled 2024-26 NAME G_total 1.021 [0.997, 1.044]; 90% CI [1.001, 1.041] inside [0.90, 1.11] (TOST p < 0.0005, Holm 0.002). All nine yearly point estimates lie in [0.95, 1.10]; the 95% CIs lie inside the band only for 2024, 2025, 2026. Pool breaks: Wald p = 0.51 (paper-level); year-level slope-change differences ACC-REJ -0.017 [-0.109, 0.074], ACC-WD [-0.290, 0.252]: no evidence of a difference, equivalence at +/-0.1 not established (WD comparison uninformative). The decision stage is not identified: the audit-implied selection-only G_total is [0.880, 1.070] (D4) / [0.867, 1.081] (WP4 canonical), which crosses the 0.90 margin.

H4b.statement: Depletion of LLM and outsider markers: pooled 2024-26 G_total < 1 for the L-union and O-union; G_desk x G_exit < 1 for the L-union.
H4b.verdict_label: partially supported: L-union total depletion not significant after Holm; the significant pre-decision L depletion is carried by R24 title words, whose depletion pre-dates 2024; the O depletion lies at the unidentified decision stage
H4b.notes: L-union total 0.975 [0.951, 1.001] (one-sided p 0.0295; Holm step x2 -> 0.059, not significant); desk x exit 0.981 [0.972, 0.992] (camera-ready-free 0.976 [0.961, 0.991]). Without R24 the L-union is neutral: total 0.998 [0.972, 1.027], camera-ready-free pre-decision 0.990 [0.974, 1.007]. R24 total 0.807 [0.740, 0.874] vs 2018-23 0.815 [0.631, 1.009] (post/pre 0.990 [0.788, 1.288]). O-union total 0.807 [0.749, 0.870] sits at the decision stage (0.812 [0.757, 0.871]); its camera-ready-free pre-decision gain is 1.035 [1.000, 1.072]; the identified O depletion is ALL-CAPS at exit (camera-ready-free pre-decision 0.901 [0.817, 0.984]).

H4c.statement: Accepted-only Kobak-style lower bound on LLM-styled abstracts understates the all-submission bound by >= 15% relative in each of 2024-26.
H4c.falsification: accepted-only bound >= 0.9 x all-submission bound in 2024 and 2025
H4c.verdict_label: partially supported: direction (ratio < 1) supported; the >= 15% magnitude is met in point estimates only, and the falsification condition is met under the post hoc pre-ChatGPT baseline
H4c.notes: Ratios accepted/all 0.800 / 0.714 / 0.502 (2024/25/26); P(ratio >= 0.85) = 0.209 / 0.078 / 0.079 (IUT p 0.209, Holm 0.209); P(ratio >= 1) max 0.007. Post hoc baseline max(p2021, p2022): 0.9005 / 0.9011 / 0.9954, which meets the falsification condition (>= 0.9 in 2024 and 2025).

H4d.statement: Within NA (withdrawn vs rejected), NAME coefficient > 0 in the cross-section, <= 0 within last-position key, and the two differ (pre-registered reading: the excess is between keys).
H4d.verdict_label: partially supported: the pre-registered contrast holds, but with topic100 FE the cross-sectional excess is not significant; most of it is topic composition, and the residual excess sits with single-paper keys that the within design cannot test
H4d.notes: Cross 4.06 pp (se 0.96) vs within -0.70 (se 1.08); difference 4.77 (se 0.75). With topic100 FE: cross 0.84 [-1.05, 2.74], within -1.74, difference 2.58 (se 0.71). Single-paper keys: 6.91 (se 1.36), with topic FE 5.60 (se 1.33). Key x year + topic FE within -2.65 [-5.20, -0.11].

H4e.statement: Accepted-only estimates fall within +/-10% of all-submission estimates for M metrics; deviations concentrate in O and L; each gap split into selection and editing (audit).

atlas.label: Peak years of top-30 title fashions (agreement with all)

H4e.verdict_label: partially supported (descriptive): prevalence-type M statistics within +/-10%; the ITS break (effect scale) and the colon-premium trend are not
H4e.notes: M 9/11 within +/-10% on the effect scale (accepted-only 9/10); outside: ITS slope change (NAME), effect scale; Colon-premium trend, 2018-26 (decided-only). L 7/9 (median |log ratio| 0.037); M 9/11 (median |log ratio| 0.018); O 1/4 (median |log ratio| 0.160).

editing-corrected 90% CI inside the TOST margins

decision_stage_bound.gate: No title-feature acceptance gain is identified: every tipping point lies inside the audit DiD 95% CI.

postdec_withdrawals_consistent.note: exit/dec/predec only: G_total = P(s3)/P(s0) does not involve s2 and is identical by construction

desk_rejection_timing_2026.reason: 100.0% of 2026 desk rejections carry a modification timestamp on/after the decision date (median 2026-02-12 14:51:43.630000); the timestamp records a bulk post-decision update, not the desk-rejection date

deviations: Pooled gains are year-standardised (each year's stage prevalence weighted by its s0 size); raw pooling is reported as robustness. PLAN does not specify the pooling. The choice was made when d4_stage_gains was written; it is not separately timestamped before the first estimates.
OTHER rows (71 in 2018 with unknown decision) are dropped from the D4 stage frame.

ALL-CAPS title = casing class all_caps (whole title in capitals), matching the scout record (LITERATURE_BRIEF s3.5: 'ALL-CAPS titles ... accepted at 16.5% vs 40.5%'). The earlier statement that the pilot used the NAME-lead orthography is not supported by the scout record and is withdrawn; the NAME-lead variant is reported as allcaps_name (secondary). The pilot's exact period for 0.37 is not documented.
L-union = any binary L marker (title typography, R24, R26, F24, F26, abstract em dash); the continuous style density is reported separately and is not in the union. Em dash = abstract em dash.

F26 in the L set is abstract-only (F26 words, U+2011 or en-dash compounds in the abstract); the features_v2 f26 also fires on title typography (104 of 3,253 2024-26 F26 papers via the title only). Its title part is a subset of title typography, so the L-union is unchanged; L_abstract and the F26 rows changed slightly.

Year-specific style density re-implements the scout rule on the frozen scout style pool (analyses/d4_lexicon.json); selected words 123/150/223 for 2024/25/26. Bootstrap CIs re-select the words in every replicate (variant density_reselect). T4.1 density ORs still condition on the full-sample list.

Decision-stage tipping point accounts for accepted papers inside s2: D* = (P3 - P2)/(1 - a2). The plan's 1.8 pp pilot ignored the (1 - a2) factor; with it NAME's tipping point is 2.9 pp (total-gain tipping point 1.0 pp).

Snapshot module computed inside d4_bias_atlas from cache/arxiv_audit.jsonl because outputs/snapshot/ did not exist at run time. WP4's canonical outputs (T4_2_tipping_points.csv) agree on point estimates; WP4's primary DiD interval is wider (pseudo-flip), so both are reported and gate statements use WP4's. WP4's abstract audit (330 v1 abstracts) makes F24 auditable; D4's own copy audits titles only.
Colon premium: no accepted-only version exists; the published-only analogue is decided-only (ACC vs REJ). The pre-registered trend enters the M count; the level is supplementary.
OR-type atlas statistics (ITS slope change, colon premium) are compared as ratios of log-ORs (effect scale) with delta-method CIs; the original OR-ratio comparison is kept in or_ratio columns.
Opener-entropy and JSD intervals are random-selection null bands (pivot), not CIs; they are excluded from the 90%-CI count. The paper bootstrap produced intervals excluding the point estimate.
H4c: post hoc baseline sensitivity max(2021, 2022) added because ICLR 2023 camera-ready abstracts post-date ChatGPT; under it the falsification condition is met.

Post-decision withdrawals: the primary stage frame follows _core.pool_flags (only the 2026 wd_post rows stay in s2, as in PLAN section 0 and the frozen CT6). A consistent definition (any withdrawn row with an accept/reject decision, plus 2025-26 withdrawals timestamped on/after the decision date) is reported for the exit, decision and pre-decision gains and in H4d.

H4d: primary population REJ u WD (2024-26), outcome = withdrawn incl. 2026 post-decision withdrawals; last position = max list position (D2 convention); controls year FE, log authors, llm_topic. The topic100-FE contrast is co-primary after the audit.
Holm over {H4a, H4b, H4c, H4d} with intersection-union p-values; BH over T4.1 and the atlas.
Early vs late 2026 desk rejections not testable: all 737 desk-rejection timestamps fall on/after the decision date (bulk update).
Desk-stage continuation-ratio logits fitted for 2024-26 only (2018-23 has 0-19 desk rejections a year).
language: Associational; declared profile keys are not persons; list positions are partition labels.
